Bewilderment.name: Bewilderment
Bewilderment.description:
This item bears a hidden curse. While invested, the bearer's mind is gripped by @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}, a creeping confusion that does not relent.

  • The bearer suffers the @Condition[disoriented] condition for as long as the item remains invested.

  • The bearer's maximum Morale is reduced by 25% per tier of this affix.

Playtesting

Cursed affixes do not yet have a mechanism to conceal their nature from players. Until the curse is revealed through gameplay, the bearer's player should roleplay ignorance of its presence and effects.

Lunar Shield.name: Lunar Shield
Lunar Shield.description:
While invested, you are surrounded by a defensive buffer powered by cosmological energy that fluctuates according to the phases of Ember's elemental moons. For each moon, you gain resistance equal to this prefix's Tier while that moon is Waxing or Waning, or twice the Tier while it is Full:

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.smc0OuMxsxfcSdhR]{Aura} - Lightning

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.5pD8lxiilJJXOgoa]{Cora} - Acid

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.LKptgmc56euSOb0G]{Ragen} - Fire

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.RkdBtFQk7STvMbV2]{Mayis} - Cold

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.zkmWSB32y8Fbc4UL]{Orbis} - Psychic

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.3Oywe0peo57dQT9j]{Akon} - Piercing
